packages.name: Domains
packages.description: Reverse proxy with free, automatically renewed HTTPS certificates. Point your own domains at this NAS and forward them to any host and port - another device, a container, or EthOS itself - without touching nginx by hand. Caddy issues and renews Let's Encrypt certificates on its own, and the stack keeps routing even when EthOS is restarting.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.1.1: read certificates from Caddy's actual storage root (/data/caddy/certificates), so the certificate list and expiry show up. per-route response headers and permanent redirects, plus a bulk route import so an existing proxy configuration (for example Nginx Proxy Manager) can be migrated in one step. 1.0.0: initial release: Caddy-based reverse proxy with automatic Let's Encrypt certificates, per-domain routes to any host:port (including EthOS itself), WebSocket and streaming support, live certificate expiry, a DNS preflight check and the proxy log in one native EthOS window.

packages.name: EthOS AntiVirus
packages.description: ClamAV antivirus with a native EthOS window: full, custom and scheduled scans, quarantine copies, scan logs and configurable scan options. Read-only scans of /home, /mnt and /media; signatures update automatically.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.1.4: Browse… in the scan target and schedule forms uses the EthOS folder picker, restricted to /home, /mnt and /media. 2.1.3: health/status report which shares are visible in the scanner container and the UI warns instead of failing scans silently. 2.1.2: fix scans failing with 'not visible in the scanner container' — the UI container now mounts /home, /mnt and /media read-only at /scan. 2.1.1: light and dark themes follow the EthOS appearance toggle. 2.1.0: Synology-style options — quarantine copies, whitelist/file-type/size filters, smart scan, scan log, scheduled scans, definition info and a persistent package data volume. 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; package service bound to loopback and reached through an authenticated proxy. 1.0.1: clearer first-start status and longer scan timeout.

packages.name: EthOS Welcome
packages.description: A tiny static welcome page for your NAS, served by nginx on port 8090.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.2: light and dark themes, honours the ?theme= passed by EthOS and falls back to prefers-color-scheme. 1.0.1: Package Center icon. 1.0.0: initial release: static welcome page with a live clock.

packages.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
packages.description: A tiny two-player tic-tac-toe game that opens directly in an EthOS window. No container, no port.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.1.0: light and dark themes follow the EthOS appearance toggle. 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; no nginx container and no port. 1.0.0: initial nginx version.
